## History

Maria lived at Patty's Place with her aunt, Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford. After being visited by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), she and her aunt agreed to rent the cottage to the girls while they traveled to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). Maria has never been married.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055)_

## Relationships

### [Patty](../character/patty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

Maria is the niece of Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and served as her traveling companion during their trips abroad. The two women lived together at Patty's Place before renting their cottage to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends for the school year while they prepared to travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), +2 more_
